# Tri Cities — Company Canon

<!-- GENERATED from canon.json — do not edit by hand. Edit the canon; this file is rebuilt on every change. -->

## Policies (always true)

- **Accepted work**: TCR takes bathroom remodels, kitchen remodels, and home additions (single- and multi-story). Ground-up new construction is a hard no; commercial or exterior-only work is evaluated case-by-case.
- **Change orders**: Change orders are written, signed, and paid in full before the associated work begins.
- **Deposit gates**: Demo never begins without the signed contract in hand and the 25% deposit received; payment runs 25% at contract, 25% at demo start, 25% at rough-in inspection, 25% at completion.
- **Fixed-price contracts only**: Fixed-price contracts exclusively; time-and-materials is never used for residential work.
- **Friday punch-list**: Fridays are punch-list days, not new demo starts.
- **Interior trade concurrency**: No more than two trades work concurrently inside the building; exterior trades carry no such limit.
- **Job photo documentation**: Before, during, and after photos are captured into every job's inputs folder.
- **Local pricing confirmation**: Allowance pricing from national-average retail data must be confirmed against local Tri-Cities supplier pricing before any order is placed.
- **Margin floor**: Gross margin floor is 30%; below that, walk.
- **Minimum job size**: Minimum job size is $15,000; smaller leads are referred out.
- **Monday customer updates**: Every active customer gets a weekly Monday update.
- **Never split framing**: Framing is never split between a sub and the in-house crew.
- **No demo without materials**: Never demo without the next phase's materials on site, and never schedule a job before the customer's final material selections are made.
- **Permits always**: Permits are pulled on every applicable job; skipping permits to save time is never acceptable.
- **Pricing presentation**: Materials are billed at cost plus 15% markup, itemized in estimates; labor is never itemized to shopping customers — total-vs-total only. Discounts are rare; prefer scope reduction over price cuts.
- **Rock excavation excluded**: Rock excavation is always excluded from base scope; encountering rock becomes a change order, never absorbed.
- **Shower waterproofing**: Kerdi or Wedi waterproofing membrane goes behind every tiled shower — non-negotiable.
- **Warranty terms**: Labor is warranted 1 year post-completion; materials are covered per manufacturer warranty.
- **Winter weather window**: Foundation and framing are not scheduled between mid-December and mid-February; every outdoor-touching phase carries a 20% timeline buffer.

## Defaults (assumed true unless overridden)

- **Hybrid staffing split**: assume the in-house crew handles anything the customer will see every day for 20 years — framing, drywall, tile, carpentry, finish — while subs handle licensed trades (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), demo, cabinet install, countertops, glass, and larger paint scopes — unless job specifics or crew capacity dictate otherwise.
- **In-house vs sub threshold**: assume if the in-house crew can do it in a day, use them; if it would take 3+ days, sub it — unless the work is licensed-trade or the never-split-framing policy applies.
